title: THE DECAYED STATE OF LIBERAL WOMEN

sense.text:
Wisdom for the week: a king kept two horses. One he fed and never rode, the other he rode every day through rain and stone. When war came he rode the thin, scarred one. Comfort makes you look strong; struggle makes you strong. Your hard days are not punishment, they are training.

So James says “count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations.” The divers temptations are different struggles, and not only money: health, hardship, all kinds of trials. Find it joy when you fall into them.
Why joy? “Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.” The struggle is there to try your faith, and you have to have patience while you go through it.

“But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.” When you go through struggles you learn to become a better person. God puts you through different struggles in life to mold you, train you and train your spirit.

So don’t hate struggle. It is training you to be strong. Let us struggle and grow and be strong.

precepts.why:
“For gold is tried in the fire”: if you are gold, you are going to go through fire, and the fire is the struggles that we all have to go through in life. “And acceptable men in the furnace of adversity”: if you are acceptable, you have to go through adversity, and that adversity, that fire, trains you and makes you strong.

As the saying goes, hard times create strong men, strong men create good times, and good times, the comforts, create weak men. The brother who goes through hard things is made stronger; the brother who is comfortable in the good times is made weak. That is the trying of the faith James speaks of.

sense.text: Something rushed over in last week’s lesson. The disciples came asking “Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?” That was not a righteous spirit. The disciples had the state of mind at that point that they were trying to be better than each other.

Christ called a little child, set him in the midst of them and said “Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.” To be converted is to change the way you think. Christ is correcting the disciples: change that way of thinking, that you want to be better than one another, and humble yourself like a child. Unless you do, you are not getting the kingdom.

This shows that while the disciples walked with Christ they were not converted as yet. They were still learning. It is the same with a lot of us coming into the truth today, and it applies to all of us.
“Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.” The greatest is the one who humbles himself.

precepts.why:
“Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.” At this time Peter was not converted as yet. The Lord said, when you are converted, strengthen your other eleven brothers, help build them up.

So even Peter was not converted then. Conversion takes time. The apostles became great leaders, but in the beginning they were students. They had to learn humility and get rid of pride. They had to be converted.

sense.text:
For the last sixty years a war has been waged on the black community, and it has been exploiting our weakness. The black man’s weakness is the black woman, and the white man understands that.

“Giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel”: the woman is weaker than us. That is why, when Satan waged war against Adam, he went through his weakness, the woman. And that is why the hundred and forty-four thousand in Revelation 14 are those not defiled with women; their weakness will not be woman.

The woman’s weakness is her emotions. She can be manipulated, and the white man can trick her, the same way Satan played with Eve’s emotion and she said the devil tricked her. Sisters, learn to control your emotions.

We come down hard on the sisters because of the important role a woman plays in the nation. Our enemy understands your importance better than you do: to destroy the black man, he destroys the black woman first. Take the man out of the household and make her think she doesn’t need a man. A strong woman and an independent woman are two different things. Our righteous foremothers were strong women: a strong woman builds up her husband, keeps the family together and helps him become successful, and if she gets a good job she uses it for her family. An independent woman oppresses her husband, argues with him, won’t listen to him, and ultimately leaves him looking for happiness. The independent woman is the liberal woman.

“They erred in the knowledge of God”: our people erred in the knowledge of God. “But whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance”: there is a war going on right now and our people are ignorant, they don’t know they are in a war. The liberal women don’t understand that these things were set up to destroy them and their nation.

“Those so great plagues called they peace.” The great plagues are living under oppression and worshipping a white man that doesn’t look like you. You are comfortable worshipping a god that doesn’t look like you, comfortable with the nine to five that keeps you away from your kids, and you call that peace: I’m happy, I got a good job, I got a nice house. But you are ignorant. You live in a war of ignorance that is waged on you to destroy you and your people. I don’t need no man, and your son grows up to be a gang member and your daughter grows up to be a hoe, and you don’t know what happened.

“For whilst they slew their children in sacrifices”: these are liberal ideas, democracy, Christianity. When you commit abortion, that is a sacrifice unto Satan. You black women that love killing babies at Planned Parenthood are committing murder and sacrificing your child.

The “revellings of strange rites” are the partying, the promiscuous loose sex.

“They kept neither lives nor marriages any longer undefiled”: that is what is going on in the black community. Marriages are not kept undefiled any more, because of everything in the verses above, because you are ignorant and have been lied to that you don’t need a man. You divorce and want to remarry.

Blood, manslaughter, theft, dissimulation, corruption, unfaithfulness, perjury: all of that is going on in the black community, because of the liberal ideas taught to our women. The woman is the one who teaches the kids, and the kids grow up and become the men that lead the nation. That is why Esau comes for her mind. If the women live in ignorance they teach the kids to love Esau, love the white man, love white Jesus and hate themselves, and a lot of these young kids grow up homosexual, most of the time because they grew up with only their mama.

“Disquieting of good men, forgetfulness of good turns, defiling of souls”: what caused all of these things is the liberal woman, liberal ideas, democracy.

“Changing of kind” is Christianity: you are a woman and want to be a man, you are a man and dress like a woman. And some of you brothers watching that trans porn crap, better stop playing with that thing.

“Disorder in marriages” is another thing liberals push. All of these things come from liberals: liberal Christians wear dresses, homosexuality and lesbianism are okay with them, and they push sexual liberation. The marriage is out of order when the woman is above the man and ruling him. Sisters, you have to fall in line; and any brother who allows his woman to rule and control him is not getting the kingdom. That does not mean you never listen to your wife when she is a doctor and understands certain things. It means you are the head of your house and you have to guide.

“Adultery, and shameless uncleanness”: the orgies, all that crazy stuff, the two, three women at the same time, women having sex with all types of different men. And the objects: pushing stuff up in you that is not supposed to be going up in there.

“For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” All of this comes from worshipping idols. It starts with Christianity, democracy and being a damn liberal, and all of it falls under one. There is so much evil in the black community because we worship idols, we worship white Jesus, and that is why we hate ourselves and our people. Christianity tells you you can be promiscuous, you can divorce, you can be a homosexual.

precepts.why:
This is the state of mind of liberal women. “As for my people, children are their oppressors”: the woman’s job is to teach the nation, starting with the kids. Teach them right and they grow up productive in the nation. “And women rule over them”: that is the black community today. The children have become our oppressors, joining gangs, robbing and killing their own people, the drill music murdering each other, because the woman is not teaching them right.

“O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.” Who is leading God’s people? These independent liberal women. Should your wife be leading you? Oh hell no, that is out of order. God says if you allow a woman to lead you she will cause you to err, just as Eve brought the fruit to Adam and Adam did it. In the marches, Black Lives Matter, who is in the front leading the black men? Liberal lesbian black women. You follow a woman and she will destroy the way of your path, which is walking in righteousness. That is the disorder in marriages Wisdom speaks of.

“How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter?” God calls the woman a backsliding daughter. It speaks of the nation as a whole too, but this is the black woman.

“For the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.” That is what society has set up today: women on top, ruling society, compassing men. When women rule over men and want to be the head over men, that is out of order. That is the new thing on the earth, and God calls it backsliding. It is the disorder in marriages.

sense.text:
“Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people.” It is our job, brothers, to set our face against them. Sisters, we get on you because the white man has tricked you and you have been deceived, and God commands us to, because you play an important role in rebuilding the nation. For the last sixty years the white man has been using you to destroy the black community, so God commands us to set our face against these liberal black women, these free thinkers who want to do whatever they want.

“Which prophesy out of their own heart”: out of their own emotions. I don’t feel it’s wrong wearing pants, it’s cold out; I don’t see nothing wrong with a blonde wig; Jesus loves everybody. Shut the hell up. God says you are not to wear what pertains unto a man. We are not listening to what comes from your heart and your emotions.

“And prophesy thou against them.” We prophesy against you so that you see your wrongs and change. We are trying to undo the damage the white man has done to our community through our sisters.

“The vile person shall be no more called liberal”: God says the liberal people are vile. A lot of liberal things have been pushed on our people; we were not thinking like that before 1965. The liberals are the Democrats our people trust in.

Liberal means open to ideas and ways of behaving that are not conventional or traditional. Traditionally a man is with a woman; liberals say men can be with men and women with women. Traditionally the woman is in the house, guiding the house and raising the kids; liberals call that slavery and send her to work while the man stays home as a house dad. Don’t be a house dad: it changes your nature and it changes hers. That is disorder in marriage. Liberal means going against traditional, lawful things. These liberal women are not traditional women; they are women that hate God. And you sisters say you want to be liberated: the white man told you you are liberated from your man. You are the only women who want to be liberated from their own men. It makes no damn sense.

“For the vile person will speak villany”: the vile person is the liberal, and they are the villain. You think Democrats love black people? No. “His heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy”: they are a bunch of hypocrites. “To utter error against the Lord”: everything these liberals set up is against God.

“To make empty the soul of the hungry”: we are the ones who hunger for righteousness, and they make it so our people don’t want to learn the word of God. “And he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail”: the drink is the word of God, and their job is to stop this truth from going forward by brainwashing the sisters.

“The instruments also of the churl are evil”: the churl is the liberals, the Democrats, and their instruments are public assistance, Section 8, all the liberal programs you thought were set up to benefit you. They were evil and set up to destroy your community. Even sending you to college was not to build your nation; it was to give you jobs so you would fight against your men, bring division and say I don’t need a man. That is why a lot of you are single: your man left because he wasn’t dealing with that.

“He deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words”: the wicked devices are the liberal programs set up for the black woman. We have been at war, and Satan has been coming for our weakness, the woman, teaching her lies that she teaches to the children. The liberals push lies, play with your emotions, and you believe it. “Even when the needy speaketh right”: even when we speak right.
“But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.” All the liberal things they stand on are the evil things they stand on.
“Rise up, ye women that are at ease.” The women profit from these liberal things; they are the ones on Section 8 and food stamps. So God says, rise up, ye women that are at ease.

A lot of black women support what Lindsay Clancy did, strangling her three children and blaming it on postpartum psychosis, because a lot of them are the same way: killing their babies in the abortion clinics. You are just like her.

“As is the mother, so is her daughter.” Our mothers and our sisters for the last sixty years are the same. They have been brainwashed with women’s liberation, feminism, that independent spirit, all those liberal ideas, thinking it is okay to kill your babies: my choice, my body. As is the mother, so is her daughter: that is the black woman.

“Thou art thy mother’s daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children.” You hate your husband. That is why there is so much divorce in our community today: our sisters hate their husbands. And she hates her children. These liberal women hate their husbands and they hate their children.

The proof is in their own words: the single mother telling women without children to keep it that way, the women who say they love their child but hate being a mom, who say do not have kids, who say mothers give up their happiness. That is how the liberal woman thinks. Lindsay Clancy hated her kids and killed her kids, and a lot of black women think the same and do the same. But the scripture says the young women should marry and bear children.

precepts.why:
“Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils”: that is what we used to do back then. We literally had kids and offered them up to idols and killed them. “And shed innocent blood”: the innocent blood is the blood of those little babies, “even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan.” We would have orgies, have kids, and offer them up to Molech.

So the mother that loathes her children is nothing new. Black women hating their kids and hating their husbands, killing them in abortion, is the same sacrifice of sons and daughters unto devils.

sense.text:
Postpartum is in the scriptures, but not depression, because you are not supposed to be depressed after you have a baby. You are supposed to be happy. Postpartum, from the Latin, means after childbirth: the period of time immediately following childbirth.

“If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation”: the days of her separation are postpartum, the days after she gave birth. “For her infirmity shall she be unclean.”

Postpartum depression was only formally recognized as a diagnosis in the United States in 1994. It is something new they came up with: white women started saying they felt depressed and wanted to kill their babies after the baby was born. It is a liberal ideology. Many of its signs, fatigue, low energy, trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, not wanting to do things, simply happen to every woman after she gives birth, and Esau took those and put crazy stuff in with them, like trouble bonding with your baby and thoughts of harming yourself or the baby. That is the devil on you. Sisters, don’t bring that liberal crap in here.
“And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.”

“And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days”: seven and thirty-three, forty days in all, and for a girl, eighty. She “shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.”

Purification in the Bible means being washed, cleansed or made holy; literally, removing what is contaminated to restore something to its natural clean state. So the days of her purifying are her being restored to her natural state. When a woman brings forth a child her body goes through a lot of changes: her belly swollen, her organs shifted, she bleeds, she has lost nutrients and minerals, she is weak and tired. Like a tomato plant that sucks the nutrients and minerals out of the soil, the baby draws them out of her. God said, you need forty days to restore yourself back to how you were. That is postpartum.

And it was not just staying away from the temple. She was in a separate place, away even from her husband, with family and midwives around her, cooking the right food to heal her and nursing her back to health. Esther was purified too, with a maid and everything she needed. In slavery we forgot these things: the herbs, the baths, the midwives, the foods to get back strength.

Today a lot of sisters give birth with no one around them. The baby is up crying, you are tired, you need help, and it becomes overwhelming. Being overwhelmed is not postpartum depression. You are supposed to have people around you. That is why the Birth of a Nation program is among us, and the sisters training as midwives, doulas, doctors and nurses need to learn and teach the right foods, the herbs, the baths. Some of the depression is nutrient depletion, and some of it is the prenatal vitamins with folic acid and the pills Esau gives you at the hospital. Esau is the devil: if you feel like killing yourself, it might be those damn vitamins you are taking. Naturally a woman is not supposed to be like that after she gives birth, and she is never supposed to be thinking about killing herself and her baby.

How a woman should feel when she has a baby: “He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children.” When you have children you are to be joyful, not like these liberal black women who hate kids and say they want freedom to do what they want with no responsibility. It is a joy to have children. Nothing is wrong with keeping house and taking care of your house. That is what God ordained for you: to be a joyful mother of children.

Don’t say, I want to finish my college degree, and put the kids last to finish your degree. Have kids in your twenties and early thirties, when you are stronger and your womb is stronger; wait until your forties and it is harder, with a lot of complications, and you might not have any.

precepts.why:
“A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come”: when you are giving birth you will be in sorrow and feel a lot of pain. “But as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.” For joy.

So don’t talk about having kids and being depressed. And now the young sisters say they are overstimulated, a new term from the liberal women on the internet and TikTok. The only person who is supposed to stimulate you and overstimulate you is your husband. Stop listening to these liberal women. Overwhelmed you can understand: sometimes a mother will be overwhelmed with the kids, and that is why it is good for us to be family and be around each other, so the kids can go to their grandmother. But after the anguish comes joy.

sense.text:
A mother on video told her son to run from the virgin and choose the woman who had been with ten men, because the virgin will be emotionally connected to him and he would have to teach her everything. Is there any wrong in teaching her everything? That is the evil, liberal state of mind; who doesn’t want a virgin? That is why some young men, the first time they sleep with someone, catch AIDS or diseases. You can tell that mother is probably a hoe herself; that is why she talks like that, telling her son to deal with the woman who has been sexing a bunch of dudes.

“If a man find a damsel that is a virgin, which is not betrothed, and lay hold on her, and lie with her, and they be found”: you talk to her, you have sex with her, and it is found out that you were sneaking around having sex with each other.

“The man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel’s father fifty shekels of silver, and she shall be his wife; because he hath humbled her, he may not put her away all his days.” If you sleep with a woman you are supposed to marry her.

Sex was ordained for a man and a woman who get married, and only between them. The way people loosely have sex today, with this one this year and another next year, is wrong. Sex is not just about pleasure. There is something spiritual behind it; that is why the two become one.

“If any man take a wife, and go in unto her, and hate her”: he hates her after he has had sex with her, “and give occasions of speech against her, and bring up an evil name upon her, and say, I took this woman, and when I came to her, I found her not a maid.”

Then her father and mother “bring forth the tokens of the damsel’s virginity unto the elders of the city in the gate.” The token of her virginity is the bloody sheet. “And yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity. And they shall spread the cloth”: and what was on that cloth was blood.

“But if this thing be true, and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel”: if there was no cloth with blood, she was brought out “to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones that she die: because she hath wrought folly in Israel.” If a woman had sex with a man she was not married to, it was found out on the wedding night. Back then a sister could not bring an excuse; she would be put to death.

Today sisters say, I used to play sports, I rode horses, that’s why there was no blood. She belongs to the streets. Brothers, don’t listen to that bull crap. Our foremothers did hard work back in the days and still had their hymen intact. The hymen is durable and stretches like rubber; something has to go up there to tear it. A lot of sisters put their fingers where they are not supposed to go, or young brothers in high school did it to them; something was done to her in the past, and that is why there is no hymen there. If there is no token, something was done in the past. It is up to the older women to teach the young girls how to take care of themselves and that nothing is to go there. If she says she is a virgin and there is no token, she’s a hoe.

Why did God give a woman a hymen? “The Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth”: the woman you married when you were both young. “Against whom thou hast dealt treacherously”: she got old, the titties sagging, her body changed, she is not the same, and now you are watching the young one and dealing treacherously with her. “Yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.” Brothers who marry a woman, she falls under your covenant.

So you had the paperwork, and you also had the sheets: the token of her virginity, the blood by which she entered into that covenant with you. She should belong to you for the rest of your life.

“And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth”: the woman you married when you were young.

“For the Lord, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away.” God hates putting away. You are not supposed to put away the woman you marry, because you and that woman are under a blood covenant. She is part of you and you are part of her. In the same way the Lord cannot just get rid of Israel, because of the oath he made with our fathers; because of that promise he is going to have mercy on us.

precepts.why: “Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.” A covenant is a promise or agreement, and the first covenant was established with blood: Moses killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood.

“For this is my blood of the new testament”: the new testament was established with Christ’s blood.

So when you marry and enter into a covenant with your wife, whose blood has to be shed? That is what the hymen is. When it breaks, that blood is her entering into a lifelong blood covenant with you. That is why taking a woman’s virginity is not a regular thing: the man who takes it, who humbles her, is the man she is supposed to be with for the rest of her life. That is why a woman cleaves to the man who did it and doesn’t forget him. God created her that way.

“Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.”

In that time, if your wife committed adultery and you put her away, she was stoned to death. Today a man kicks his wife out of the house, but back then to put away your wife for fornication was to deliver her up to death. So Christ’s words are much heavier than they sound: she has to do something worthy of death for you to put her away, because you are under a lifetime blood covenant with that woman.
